scope: Read-only source inspection and arithmetic from saved training results; no causal or fresh-case inference.

findings.internal_memory: Persistent terrain, timestamps, visits, inventory, bounds and anonymous enemy occupancy mass.
findings.reported_map: Only current visible grid; reported coverage does not measure internal memory.
findings.risk: Hardcoded uniform nine attempted moves with observation-conditioned occupancy inference; no estimated transition-law parameters.
findings.planner: Weighted graph routing, key ordering, exploration goals and five-step time-expanded control.

findings.reported_map: Current visible cells plus same-epoch walls.
findings.risk: Hardcoded nine attempted moves; hidden mass rebalanced toward assumed three-enemy total.
findings.planner: Wavefront routing, joint next-enemy scenarios and expected next-action trap risk. Includes conditional exit waiting until step185 or enemy sighting.

findings.internal_memory: Persistent terrain and landmarks; possible-arena rectangle hypotheses.
findings.risk: Fixed passability heuristics and uniform attempted moves; no estimated transition-law parameters.
findings.planner: Risk-weighted Dijkstra and five-step beam search tracking position, key mask and door state.

scoring.observation: Only reported in-bounds cells enter accuracy; coverage is outside F. Task reward includes a positive 0.1 per elapsed step.
scoring.limit: The score difference follows exactly from mean step count given these equal outcomes. Source inspection does not establish whether exit-camping activated or caused the extra steps.
